title: 1st Convocation Ceremony 2025 | KPGU
content: of hard work, perseverance, and family blessings. Emphasizing values, lifelong learning, courage, and service to society, he reminded graduates that true success lies in character as much as achievement. Shri Dr. P. P. Pandey (IPS) Former IPS Officer, Ex-DG & IG, Gujarat Police Drawing from India s timeless wisdom, Dr. P. P. Pandey reminded students that true education cultivates humility, integrity, and service. His address was uniquely delivered in Sanskrit, offering guiding mantras for life.
